(2022,).collection_policy: canonical-only, uniformly across all initialization weeks

policy.2025: zero outcome reads, fits or replay; original enriched readiness gate unchanged
policy.contrasts: home minus away QB+OL+skill and defense Out counts; both teams required
policy.coverage_control: flags-only includes the same five report/position availability flags
policy.fit: Ridge alpha 20; train-only median/indicators/scaling; common fractional-score contract
policy.following_season: select on 2023 only, assess 2024; both seasons previously examined
policy.initialization_revision: uniform canonical-only source declared before real fits after one tracking index remained unavailable; no partially collected tracking editions used for 2022
policy.positions: all Out positions must be known; no player-to-starter inference
policy.primary_horizon: pregame_refresh; this source has no Tuesday development formal reports
policy.promotion: separate research record; no active-model or original-lock changes
policy.reports: formal designations or explicit none; missing/partial/stale reports stay unknown
policy.scope: 2022 initialization; all 544 development games in 2023-2024 at both horizons
policy.secondary: both-position-covered games only; retain every game in primary metrics
policy.selection: injury must pass against both EPA and flags-only; otherwise compact EPA
policy.storage: reuse features; one context delta and prediction panel; no training copies
policy.timing: Tuesday-locked EPA/history and coefficient fits, separately by horizon
policy.unknown_contrasts: neutral zero with five availability flags, including both-known

remaining_plan: dated active/IR rosters and confirmed starters; historical forecast weather and audited adapters; enriched 2025 replay; then PEM-inspired comparison
